Game Overview

Super Squirrel Run puts players into a platformer experience centered on join a spirited squirrel in an exhilarating quest through vivid forests. Swiftly dodge obstacles, collect acorns, and unleash exciting power-ups in ever-evolving landscapes. With intuitive swipe controls, each vibrant level offers fresh and dynamic challenges for all ages, promising endless fun and adventure in this delightful runner.
